items.headline: Ohio State replaces BYU at No. 2 as Top 25 jumbled again by top-10 losses
items.description: No. 1 Miami was the only team to hold its spot in The Associated Press Top 25 on Sunday as idle Ohio State moved up to No. 2 and the poll went through another major reordering in the wake of BYU's loss at UCF and subsequent six-spot fall to No. 8.

items.headline: Wisconsin, former USC RB Bryan Jackson upset No. 16 Trojans
items.description: USC transfer Bryan Jackson scored a first-half touchdown against his former team to help Wisconsin surprise the No. 16 Trojans 24-7.

items.headline: Former Trojans back Bryan Jackson, Wisconsin upset No. 16 Southern California 24-7
items.description: — Southern California transfer Bryan Jackson scored a first-half touchdown against his former team to help Wisconsin surprise the No. 16 Trojans 24-7 on Saturday night.
